title: Hifuu Nightmare Diary ~ Violet Detector - Lucid Dreamer
description:
The early stages theme from Touhou 16.5, Violet Detector. It's melancholic and uncertain-sounding, with a happyish resolution at the end.

I don't know what ZUN did while mixing this song but everything but the lead felt inaudible to me while transcribing, so y'know, liberties were potentially taken.
